title: Microsoft SharePoint Business Data Connectivity Service Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Microsoft SharePoint. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Business Data Connectivity Service. A crafted request can trigger the deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the SharePoint application pool identity.
